explanation: Read-only SQL over the verified BDC panel.
sql: SELECT f.name AS bdc, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN h.fair_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS prior_fair_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN h.fair_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS current_fair_value, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN h.fair_value ELSE -h.fair_value END), 2) AS change_usd FROM holdings h JOIN filings f ON f.adsh = h.adsh GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY change_usd DESC, bdc LIMIT 3
